summary.text: Adam Rueda, a Humane Sustainable Future Party candidate and Bucknell University graduate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New Jersey's 5th Congressional District to Josh Gottheimer.
A former financial analyst who described himself in a 2025 survey as 28 years old, he said he co-founded a new political party, "greenparty2.0."

paragraphs.text: Rueda was raised in Andover Township (Sussex County), attended Catholic grade and middle school, and graduated from Pope John XXIII Regional High School in Sparta.

He earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, with a focus in financial management and accounting, from Bucknell University in 2019, and says he was a first-generation college graduate, vice president of his fraternity, and a participant in the university's Student Managed Investment Fund.

He has worked as a senior financial analyst at a commercial real estate brokerage in Morristown, as an interior design salesperson in Short Hills and Manhattan, and as a DJ in New York City and Brooklyn.
Rueda says he is one of 11 executive committee chairs of greenparty2.0, a party he describes as led by young professionals and activists.
He has not held elected office.
During the campaign, he emphasized environmental and health policy, gun-control reform, and campaign-finance and lobbying reform.
He received 2.9% of the vote to Josh Gottheimer's 62.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
